vachanas.kannada:
ಅರ್ಪಿತವೆಂದಡೆ ಕಲ್ಪಿತವಾಯಿತ್ತು,
ಕಲ್ಪಿತವೆಂದಡೆ ಅರ್ಪಿತವಾಯಿತ್ತು.
ಅರ್ಪಿತವನು ಕಲ್ಪಿತವನು ಅದೆಂತರ್ಪಿತವೆಂಬೆ?
''ಶಿವಾತ್ಮಕ ಸುಖಂ ಜೀವೋ ಜೀವಾತ್ಮ ಚ ಸುಖಂ ಶಿವಃ|
ಶಿವಸ್ಯ ಜೀವಸ್ಯ ತುಷ್ಟಂ ಪ್ರಾಣಲಿಂಗಿಸ್ಥಲಂ ಭವೇತ್'
ಇಂತೆಂದುದಾಗಿ,
ಅರಿವರ್ಪಿತ ಮರಹು ಅನಾರ್ಪಿತ,
ಎನ್ನ ಸ್ವಾಮಿ ಘಂಟೇಶ್ವರಲಿಂಗಕ್ಕೆ.
vachanas.transliteration:
arpitavendaḍe kalpitavāyittu,
kalpitavendaḍe arpitavāyittu.
arpitavanu kalpitavanu adentarpitavembe?
''śivātmaka sukhaṁ jīvō jīvātma ca sukhaṁ śivaḥ|
śivasya jīvasya tuṣṭaṁ prāṇaliṅgisthalaṁ bhavēt'
intendudāgi,
arivarpita marahu anārpita,
enna svāmi ghaṇṭēśvaraliṅgakke.
vachanas.translation:
When it is called "offered," it appears imagined; when it is called "imagined," it becomes truly offered.
How can one distinguish between the offered and the imagined as being truly offered?
"Śivātmakaṁ sukhaṁ jīvo, jīvātmā ca sukhaṁ Śivaḥ; Śivasya jīvasya tuṣṭaṁ, prāṇaliṅgi-sthalaṁ bhavet." — "The jīva is bliss of the nature of Śiva, and Śiva is the bliss of the individual soul. The state wherein Śiva and the jīva abide in perfect contentment and union is called the Prāṇaliṅgi-sthala."
Thus it is declared.
For the one who truly knows, it is an offering; for the one who forgets, it is no offering.
Such is the truth of my Lord, Ghaṇṭeśvaraliṅga.
